attributes.storage_note: Keep perfumes in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Store with the cap tightly closed to prevent drying. Avoid keeping near heat sources (stoves, radiators, car dashboards). For best performance, store at room temperature (below 30°C). Do not refrigerate – extreme cold may affect texture.
